name: @watermark/functions
description: The Cloudflare Pages Functions (Workers runtime) — /api/submit, /api/ask, /api/doc, the MCP endpoint, Stories/AUTH Lakebase routes. Epic #1549, Phase 2 (#1552). Stays physically at web/functions so Cloudflare Pages discovers it at the project root (wrangler compiles <project-root>/functions); this package.json just gives it a scoped dependency list. wrangler itself is mise-managed (web/mise.toml [tools]), not a devDep here. The route/store tests live under `_test/` (underscore = excluded from Pages routing) and run under the site's shared-root vitest projects config (#1555).
